gap13_correction.title: A verifiable Indian reference institution
gap13_correction.phase9_wording: No competitor demonstrates a LARGE INDIAN UNIVERSITY deployment with named referees and third-party verification.
gap13_correction.phase10_finding: FURTHER NARROWED. Protrak (ProrIISe), built jointly by IISc Bengaluru and Prorigo Software, is a NAMED INDIAN UNIVERSITY deployment with hard, vendor-published metrics: in production 6+ years, 2,500+ internal and external users, 600+ corporate licence agreements, ~200 patents filed per year, 50% IP-office time saved, 0 missed deadlines, 30% faster contract closure, ~50% cost saving versus other ELM products.
gap13_correction.surviving_claim: A named Indian university reference now exists for IP MANAGEMENT (Protrak/IPTeL, IISc). No named Indian university reference exists for INCUBATION or PROGRAMME software - the category StartupHub actually competes in. That distinction is the whole finding: the institutional reference gap is segment-specific, not universal.
